3. This is second bail application under Section 439 of Code of Criminal Procedure filed by the applicant Smt. Geeta Devi, seeking enlargement on bail during trial in connection with Case Crime No. 21 of 2021, under Sections 498A, 304B I.P.C. & 3/4 D.P. Act, registered at P.S. Rasara, District Ballia.
4. The first bail application of the applicant was rejected by this Court vide order dated 18.8.2021 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 28177 of 2021 on merits.

sentences.text: 5. Learned counsel for the applicant argued that the applicant is an old lady aged about 69 years and is suffering from various old age ailments and even she is not in a position to move without help of any person.
6. Per contra, learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for bail and argued that the first bail application of the applicant was rejected by this Court on merits by a detailed order.

It is argued that in so far as the arguments raised by the learned counsel for the applicant that the accused is suffering from various old age ailments, no such documents in support of it has been filed and even no such pleading has been made to the said effect in the affidavit filed in support of this bail application.
Hence, the present bail application be dismissed.

7. After having heard learned counsels for the parties and perusing the record, it is evident that the first bail application of the applicant was rejected by the this Court on merits by a detailed order.

In so far as the arguments of learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is suffering from various old age ailments, no such documents in support of it has been filed and even no such pleading has been made in the affidavit.
The bail application thus deserves to be rejected.
8. Accordingly, the second bail application is rejected.
